AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D

  • Cores: 16
  • L3 cache: 128MB (shared)
  • TDP: 170 W (max. boost up to 230 W)
  • Transistor size: 4 nm
Ryzen 9 9950X3D - desktop processor produced by Amd for socket AM5 that has 16 cores and 32 threads. The base clock frequency of the CPU is 4300 MHz, but due to Turbo Core technology, it can perform up to 5700 MHz. The size of the L3 cache is 128 MB. Please note that this chip has integrated graphics Radeon Graphics.
